buildNote: the kleod checkout carries two uncommitted Makefile changes needed to rebuild it on macOS: CPP is $(TOOLCHAIN)cpp, the cross preprocessor, because Apple clang's cpp defines __APPLE__ and selects IDE-only branches of include/global.h and include/gba/defines.h; and the asm/data/ pattern rule precedes the asm/ rule, because GNU Make 3.81 (macOS's) takes the first matching pattern rule, not the shortest stem, and asm/data/ files need preproc.
